    # Return the patch with the lowest left and lower coordinates
    return scarf_patches[0]

    if any(not patches[word] for word in patches):
        return "One or more objects not found in the image."

    for word in patches:

    # Use the llm_query method to get the answer

def answer_query(image, query):
    # Initialize the ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Split the query into individual colors
    colors = query.split()

    # Find patches of each color
    patches = [image_patch.find(color) for color in colors]

    # If any color is not found, return a message
    for color, patch in zip(colors, patches):
        if not patch:
            return f"No {color} objects found in the image."

    # If all colors are found, return a message
    return "All objects found in the image."
